Name: Default On Cheats
Author: EnderTedi
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wpUZagX.png[/img]﻿
Default on cheats is a modding tool, enabling 'ToggleCheats' by default
ToggleCheats is a debug command which enables the use of all debug commands in the ingame chatbox, and this mod enables it by default
Can be turned off at anytime by using the ToggleCheats debug command

Requires [i][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/i] and [i][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+
[/b][/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/K680pGv.png[/img]

Manifest.Name: DefaultOnCheats
Manifest.Description: Enable debug commands in chat by default instead of having to use debug togglecheats.
